title: Independent Thread
description: A thread section built INDEPENDENTLY on the marketplace authoring surface, from the published PARTS: Thread (the conversation composition), SectionSessionScope (the purity adapter that feeds its selector internals from the contract channels), PresenceSurface, OpeningThreadSkeleton, presenceMode, and useSettings. Imports no shipped section implementation — the composition mirrors the shipped classic one-to-one, so parity is structural and any divergence is a finding against the parts surface.
